# 1. Executionist Audit: reclaim Crown estates and curb Sejm Liberum Veto (10-year cooldown)
oe_pplc_dec_executionist_audit = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pplc_is_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pplc_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		stability >= -10
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_audit_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:burghers } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pplc_dec_executionist_audit.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pplc_dec_executionist_audit_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_audit_cd months = 120 }
			oe_pplc_shift_veto = { delta = -15 }
			add_gold = 120
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pplc_executionist_audit_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 2. Expand Batory Registered Cossack Roll (up to tier 4)
oe_pplc_dec_expand_cossack_register = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_military_reforms
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_pplc_is_host = yes
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_cossack_register }
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_pplc_cossack_register
				var:oe_pplc_cossack_register < 4
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pplc_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 100
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_cossack_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:peasants } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pplc_dec_expand_cossack_register.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pplc_dec_expand_cossack_register_tt
			oe_pplc_host_init = yes
			add_gold = -100
			set_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_cd months = 60 }
			change_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_register add = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_pplc_cossack_register min = 0 max = 4 }
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:cossacks_estate }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:cossacks_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_pplc_registered_cossacks_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}

# 3. Permanently abolish Liberum Veto and enact the Constitution of 3 May 1791
oe_pplc_dec_abolish_liberum_veto = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_pplc_is_host = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_pplc_veto_abolished }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_pplc_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		stability >= 10
		OR = {
			oe_pplc_veto_tamed = yes
			current_year >= 1785
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:clergy } }
	option = {
		name = oe_pplc_dec_abolish_liberum_veto.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_pplc_dec_abolish_liberum_veto_tt
			oe_pplc_enact_may3_constitution = yes
		}
	}
}
